record.title: the claim, as an assertion
record.stamp: documented | open | hold — the evidentiary tier, NOT an importance rating
record.beats: every beat this claim informs; a claim can inform several
record.corroboration: count of DISTINCT PUBLISHERS, not of links. Three links from one aggregator counts as one.
record.derived: how the claim reached the page, including verification rounds

beat.state: the beat's current condition as fields; this is what a diff runs over
beat.unknown: what this beat does NOT establish. Never omitted.
